$comment: Unit prices of AWS in US East (N. Virginia), on demand, in US dollars, as consulted on the date below. Each one names the official pricing page and the file of the AWS Price List API it was read from (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, offer, version and usage type). confirmed: false would mark a price that could not be confirmed there; free is the monthly amount the Price List gives at $0 (the always-free tier), used only in the column with the free tier. scripts/cost/estimate.mjs computes docs/cost.md from this file and usage.json.
